sources.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The introduction and trusted-access section identify Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 as the same model with different safeguards. No nominal total or active parameter count is provided; sizes of protein models optimized by Mythos are not sizes of Mythos.

sources.title: Claude Mythos 5.1 model overview
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact claude-mythos-5-1 specifications and the current comparison table report context, output, pricing, latency, thinking and cutoff dates, with no total or active parameter column. Confirms the prior exact-model capability evidence.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Fresh official 212-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:48 UTC; independently searched the full extracted text and read sections 1 and 1.1. Section 1 explicitly identifies Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 as configurations sharing identical model weights. Section 1.1 describes pretraining followed by post-training and fine-tuning without naming a sized base model. No nominal total or active parameter count found; parameter mentions concern inference controls or evaluation tasks.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Mythos 5.1 Summary Table
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 summary tables reconfirm the same underlying model and describe pretraining and post-training, but report no nominal total, active count, or named sized base.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes: September 1, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicit launch entry names claude-mythos-5-1, 1M context and always-on adaptive thinking. Tool choice auto and none remain supported; forced any/tool choices are rejected.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, which uses vision to process document text and images.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API services are offered under contractual use rights; reverse engineering/duplication is restricted and intellectual-property rights are reserved. Supports descriptive proprietary licensing classification.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh official 230-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48 UTC; independently searched full text and inspected later comparison material. Contains Fable/Mythos 5.1 evaluations but no nominal total or activated-parameter specification for either configuration. Its effort parameter controls test-time compute, not an active weight count.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh official 148-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:47 UTC; independently searched full text and inspected comparison material. Fable 5.1 comparisons report performance, token usage and costs; no nominal total or activated-parameter column or specification for Fable/Mythos 5.1 was found.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: Fresh official 144-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48 UTC; independently searched full text and inspected comparison material for retrospective counts. No nominal total or activated-parameter specification for Mythos 5.1 or its identical-weight Fable 5.1 configuration found.

sources.title: Claude Mythos
sources.evidence: Product-family page lists Mythos 5.1 as a Mythos-class release and documents vetted access for cyberdefenders and life scientists.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Mythos 5.1 record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead accessed; used to identify the exact variant, not as primary technical verification.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: Fresh official 319-page predecessor card retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:18:49 UTC; independently searched full text and read introduction/training sections. Confirms Fable 5/Mythos 5 share weights with each other, but provides no nominal size to inherit and no assertion that the 5.1 model is an unchanged-size variant of a named sized base.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 model overview
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 for the explicit identical-weight counterpart. Describes Mythos 5.1 as sharing Fable 5.1 specifications and pricing. The comparison table has context/output/pricing/latency/thinking/cutoff columns but no total or active parameter count; predecessor wording supplies no sized-base inference.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 to establish the later-card search scope: the shared September 5.1 card is followed by Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and October Haiku 5.5 cards, all independently inspected for retrospective parameter disclosures.

sources.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
sources.evidence: October 23, 2026 first-party research found through fresh focused searches and opened October 27. Its newer-model analysis compares Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5 and an internal model using behavior rates; it contains no model parameter count or named sized lineage for Mythos 5.1.

sources.title: Mythos 5.1 / Fable 5.1 training data summary archive
sources.evidence: Secondary lead opened October 27, 2026, not used as primary verification. The archived training-content summary repeats the shared-model relationship and discusses training tokens/images. Its billion/trillion figures measure training data, not total or active model parameters; it yields no candidate numeric size.

name.note: Official product name and exact API identifier agree.

developer.note: Anthropic announces and documents this model.

family.note: Catalog slug corresponds to the explicitly named Mythos-class product family.

release_date.note: Explicit exact-model launch date; release-note entry and system-card cover agree.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no developer-published nominal total. Mythos 5.1 and Fable 5.1 explicitly share identical weights, so a published Fable 5.1 size could transfer, but neither configuration has one in the checked sources. Predecessor and later first-party comparisons supply no sized-base inference.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review checked active counts separately in exact-model sources and later Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 comparisons. No activated-parameter count or definition was found for either identical-weight configuration. Inference effort settings, token usage and costs do not establish active parameters.

architecture.note: Inspected primary cards describe training, not Transformer/dense/MoE structure. Exact-model Anthropic and Transformer Circuits research searches supplied no supporting architecture disclosure.

modalities.note: Exact reference confirms text/image input and text output; active-model PDF support establishes PDF document input, not a distinct native neural modality.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is always on for this exact model.

tool_call.note: Exact-model release notes preserve automatic tool use; unsupported forced tool-choice modes do not imply absence of tool calling.

description.value: Restricted Claude model for advanced cybersecurity and biology research workflows
description.note: Conservative description agrees with the documented trusted access programs and research focus.

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked Anthropic sources. Mythos 5.1 and Fable 5.1 share identical model weights, but neither has a published size.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains null/undisclosed nominal total and active counts. Reopened exact Mythos/Fable 5.1 specifications, launch, Transparency Hub and card index; independently inspected the 212-page shared card, 319-page predecessor and later 230/148/144-page Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 cards. Explicit identical weights make the Fable 5.1 relationship usable, but no numeric size is published in the checked sources. Focused searches for total/active counts, billion/trillion sizes and named bases led to October 23 first-party alignment comparisons and a secondary training-summary archive; neither supplies a size. Other field assessments and prior non-parameter corrections are preserved.
